shots.frame: Medium on the captain at the wheel, the compass housing before him.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in toward the wheel across the whole shot; he turns the spokes a hand's breadth.
shots.camera: on the quarterdeck planking at the binnacle, level with the wheel hub
shots.at_rest: The captain's hand rests on the wheel's upper spoke, the brass compass housing at the LEFT.
shots.end: The wheel stands a quarter turned, his hand at the lower spoke.

shots.frame: Medium on the captain crossing the cabin from the chart table.
shots.motion: He walks at a normal walking pace from the window to the door; the camera holds a locked-off frame.
shots.camera: at the chart table's near corner, level with the lamp
shots.at_rest: The captain stands at the stern window, the chart table between him and the door.
shots.end: The captain reaches the cabin door, his hand closing on the latch.

shots.frame: Close on the captain braced where the boat's gunwale rises against the rail.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in toward his face a hand's breadth; spray crosses the lamplight.
shots.camera: inside the boat at the forward thwart, looking aft
shots.at_rest: His face fills the picture, his head a quarter of the frame's height, the boat's gunwale a dark bar at the BOTTOM.
shots.end: Spray stands in beads on his cheek, the gunwale still a dark bar below.

shots.frame: Close over the brother's shoulder on the captain braced at the rail.
shots.motion: The camera pushes in toward the captain a hand's breadth; he lifts his chin.
shots.camera: at the rail's near end, level with the captain's collar
shots.at_rest: The captain holds the rail with both fists, his head half of the frame's height, the sea a grey band behind him.
shots.end: His chin is up, his eyes on the horizon line at the TOP of the frame.

shots.frame: Medium on the captain at the kitchen table, the oil lamp burning between the loaf and the knife.
shots.motion: He draws the knife toward the loaf a hand's breadth; the camera holds a locked-off frame.
shots.camera: at the dresser's near end, level with the lamp chimney
shots.at_rest: The captain sits square at the kitchen table, the loaf under his left hand, the lamp burning at the RIGHT of the frame; the curate's shoulder enters the lower LEFT.
shots.end: The knife stands in the cut loaf, crumbs scattered on the deal board.

shots.frame: Medium on the captain leading the curate into the scullery, the doorway framing them both.
shots.motion: They walk at a normal walking pace through the doorway; the camera holds a locked-off frame.
shots.camera: at the kitchen's far wall, level with the door latch
shots.at_rest: The curate follows at the kitchen door, his lantern raised to shoulder height.
shots.end: Both men stand inside the scullery, the lantern light on the stone sink.
